rows.label: Area utilisation
rows.why: Share of reachable level that sees real traffic. Low means art budget nobody sees.

rows.label: Route coherence
rows.why: How much travel is committed movement vs milling. Low means no readable routes.

rows.label: Traffic concentration
rows.why: Gini of traffic across the level. High means everyone funnels into one place.

rows.label: Extraction rate
rows.why: Inferred share of runs that end at an exfil zone rather than in death.

rows.label: Storm engagement
rows.why: Share of matches that last long enough for the storm to exist at all.

rows.label: PvP share of kills
rows.why: Human-vs-human kills as a share of all kills. The genre premise.

rows.label: Shared matches
rows.why: Share of matches containing more than one human.
